title: Verify review-lens v2 migration — run SPEC suite and close any gaps
goal: Confirm the already-committed review-lens v2 migration satisfies all acceptance SPECs (SPEC-1 through SPEC-19); fix any gap found before the PR is opened.

steps.description: Run `npm test` (or the targeted review-lens test script directly) to establish which of SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 pass and which fail. This is the gating step. Expected: all 19 green. Any failing SPEC pinpoints the exact gap addressed in a subsequent step.

If SPEC-4 or SPEC-5 fail: confirm `_llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` is the parse call at line ~330 of plugin.sh and that `_review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` validates `.findings | type == "array"`. Fix if missing or incorrect. (Mirrors security-lens; ADR-028 §Migration, #2035.)

If SPEC-1, SPEC-2, SPEC-3, SPEC-13, or SPEC-15 fail: verify `_review_lens_write_result` writes `{result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason}` and is called on every terminal exit path — router failure, unparseable reply, normalization failure, rc=130 (interrupted), and rc=10 (exhausted). Fix any mis-wired or missing branch.

If SPEC-14 fails: verify `_review_lens_budget_guidance` and `_review_lens_wallclock_guidance` are sourced from `_route_resolve_max_turns` / `_route_resolve_timeout` respectively (not hand-copied literals), and their output is appended to the prompt before `route_to_model`. Fix sourcing or call-site if wrong.

If SPEC-7, SPEC-12, SPEC-16, SPEC-17, SPEC-18, or SPEC-19 fail: apply the missing manifest field(s) — result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, primary:true on lens_result, provides.events (exactly 3), provides.role:review_lens, inputs with only id+required (no path/type/producer_stage), hooks.cleanup absent with ADR-054 §7 comment.

If SPEC-11 or SPEC-10 fail: verify (a) `_review_lens_write_result` body contains no hardcoded artifact filename literals (no `lens-*.json` or `scope-manifest.md` strings); (b) no merge-action coercion tokens (`approve|request_changes|"block"`) appear in plugin.sh or lib/charters.sh. Fix any violation.

Run `npm test` a final time to confirm all SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 assertions are green with the tree committed first (so the mutation tier engages). This satisfies the DoD `npm test green` and `reddens at merge-base` requirements.

notes: The implementation is fully committed on branch zbuild/issue-1840-ci across multiple prior commits. Confirmed by reading current files: manifest.yaml (95 lines) has result_contract:2, valid_verdicts:[complete,degraded], provides.role:review_lens, provides.events (3 events: review_lens.failed, review_lens.redaction_failed, review_lens.unparseable), primary:true on lens_result, config.router.{timeout_s:300, max_turns:10}, inputs with only id+required, no hooks.cleanup with ADR-054 §7 comment. plugin.sh (396 lines) has _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok schema gate (line ~55), _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate at line 330, _review_lens_write_result on all terminal exit paths (rc=0 degrade, rc=130 interrupted at lines ~298-304, rc=10 exhausted at lines ~307-313, normalization fail), _review_lens_budget_guidance and _review_lens_wallclock_guidance sourced from _route_resolve_max_turns/_route_resolve_timeout, _review_lens_interrupt_handler trap registered. Test file (882 lines) has SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 covering all acceptance criteria including backward-compat assertions preserved in SPEC-9. Steps 2-6 are contingency-only; estimated_lines reflects gap-filling budget, not new code. The 'reddens at merge-base' criterion is structurally satisfied: SPEC-7 through SPEC-19 assert v2 fields absent from the pre-migration codebase. The 'before/after golden diff' acceptance criterion is addressed by SPEC-8 (advisory degrade behavior unchanged) and SPEC-9 (v1 fields present and intact on success path). lib/charters.sh was not read in this pass — assumption: it contains no coercion tokens; SPEC-10 grep assertion in the test file will catch any violation at step-1. No template modification step is included because review-lens is convergence:advisory and the issue body grants no latitude to add it to a live flow. The prior plan's notes are carried forward verbatim as the exploration conclusions are identical.
